svg.title: Displacement standing waves in pipes of length L, two harmonics for each type, drawn as mirror-image envelopes inside each pipe. Pipe open at both ends: antinodes at both open ends; the first harmonic has one node in the middle, L equals half a wavelength; the second harmonic has two nodes, L equals one wavelength. Pipe closed at both ends: nodes at both closed ends; the first harmonic has one antinode in the middle, L equals half a wavelength; the second harmonic has two antinodes, L equals one wavelength. Pipe closed at the left and open at the right: a node at the closed end and an antinode at the open end; the first harmonic has L equal to a quarter of a wavelength; the next possible pattern is the third harmonic, L equals three quarters of a wavelength.
svg.text: closed at left, open at right
